submission.entrypoint: one .t.sol file: contract HyblisPoC is HyblisBase with setUp() and test_exploit() (optional step1()..stepN())

policy.network: read-only RPC for the pinned fork block only
rules: One file test/hyblis/HyblisPoC.t.sol: contract HyblisPoC is HyblisBase, importing ./HyblisBase.sol
setUp() forks once, at the pinned block, through HYBLIS_ETH_RPC; one test, test_exploit()
Separate transactions: put each in a public step1() .. stepN() and call them in order from test_exploit()
Act only as accounts from makeAddr / makeAddrAndKey, contracts you deploy, or the PoC itself
Never impersonate a protocol contract, a trusted role, a whale or a victim; protocol admins are trusted
Capital only through _fund() (or deal(), routed the same way), within the task's cap; it is subtracted from your gain
Trusted-role actions and oracle moves only through _asRole / _setPrice, as the task allows
No vm.store, vm.etch, vm.mockCall, vm.deal, hoax, ffi, files, other forks, env reads or snapshots; time moves forward only
Impact is measured on the protocol itself; your asserts and logs are ignored; profit must end in an account you control
The file must also pass in plain forge test: it is the file that is filed
